ARTICLES OF AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made on 2 March 2026 between Pelangi Residences Pte Ltd, a company incorporated in Singapore (the Employer), and Tembusu Construction Pte Ltd (the Contractor).
The Employer wishes to carry out the works known as Proposed Erection of 12 Units of Two-Storey Terrace Houses (the Project) at Lorong Pelangi Kecil, Singapore 539999.
The Contract Sum is S$4,860,000.00 (Singapore Dollars Four Million Eight Hundred and Sixty Thousand Only), exclusive of GST.
The Architect for this Contract is Mr Daniel Ong of Ong & Partners Architects.
The Quantity Surveyor for this Contract is Kestrel Cost Consultants Pte Ltd.
This Contract is based on the SIA Building Contract 2016 (Lump Sum Contract), with quantities.
Signed for the Employer and for the Contractor on the date above.

APPENDIX
Item 1. Date of Possession and Commencement: 6 April 2026
Item 2. Date for Completion: 5 October 2027
Item 3. Liquidated damages: S$2,500.00 per day
Item 4. Defects Liability Period: 12 months from the date of completion
Item 5. Performance Bond: 10% of the Contract Sum, by banker's guarantee, valid until 3 months after the end of the Defects Liability Period
Item 6. Retention: 10% of the value of work done, up to a limit of 5% of the Contract Sum
Item 7. Interim payment claims: monthly, on or before the 20th day of each month
Item 8. Final account: the Contractor shall submit the final account within 3 months after completion
Item 9. Fluctuation: not applicable
Item 10. Dispute resolution: arbitration in Singapore under the SIAC Rules
--- page ---
PARTICULAR CONDITIONS
The following amendments shall apply and shall prevail over the conditions of contract.
PC1. Clause 23(2) is amended so that the Contractor shall give written notice of any event likely to cause delay within 21 days of the start of that event, failing which no extension of time shall be granted for it.
PC2. Clause 1 is amended by adding: words in the singular include the plural.
--- page ---
PRELIMINARIES
P1. Requests for information: the Architect shall reply to each request for information within 7 working days of receiving it.
P2. Shop drawings: the Architect shall review and return shop drawings within 14 days of submission.
P3. Site meetings shall be held weekly at the site office.
P4. All notices under the Contract shall be in writing and delivered by hand or by email to the addresses in the Appendix.
